# Exploring networks

This section is reserved for interactive visualizations based on research datasets. The examples currently used elsewhere on this site are **abstract decorative illustrations**, not analytical results.
:::

::: {.site-section}

## Planned interactive content

- Historical communication networks from *Managing Maximilian*.
- Person–person, person–institution and institution-level relations from *Schematismus*.
- Connections in Tartini's musical networks.

### Embedding a public Gephi Lite visualization

Once a public, permitted visualization URL is available, an embed can be placed in the relevant project page. A template is included in `visualizations/EMBED-INSTRUCTIONS.md`.

Before publishing, check that the data can be made public and that the visualization works on mobile and with keyboard navigation. Provide an accessible textual explanation and a static fallback image where appropriate.
:::
